title: Where Northgate Protect Repairs Are Carried Out: In-Home and Depot Service
content:
Under Northgate Protect, items in a tier's in-home service categories are repaired in the customer's home, and every other item goes to depot repair. A TV is repaired in the home only when its screen is at least the tier's smallest in-home screen size; a smaller TV goes to depot repair.

| Tier | In-home service categories | Smallest TV screen repaired in the home | Shipping for depot repair |
|---|---|---|---|
| Northgate Protect Standard 2-Year | Major appliances; fitness equipment; furniture; TV and home theater | 42 inches | Prepaid label from the administrator |
| Northgate Protect Standard 3-Year | Major appliances; fitness equipment; furniture; TV and home theater | 42 inches | Prepaid label from the administrator |
| Northgate Protect Accident 2-Year | TV and home theater | 42 inches | Prepaid label from the administrator |
| Northgate Protect Accident 3-Year | TV and home theater | 42 inches | Prepaid label from the administrator |
| Northgate Protect Accident 4-Year | TV and home theater | 42 inches | Prepaid label from the administrator |
| Northgate Protect Complete Monthly | Major appliances; fitness equipment; TV and home theater | 42 inches | Prepaid label from the administrator |

- Depot shipping is paid through a prepaid label issued by the administrator, Keystone Protection Services, on every tier.
- *Hypothetical:* a 50-inch TV is repaired in the home on any tier; a 32-inch TV is below 42 inches and goes to depot repair.
